depiction_rules.notes: D027 churning groups; differentiate from devas by position and muted garments.

visual_bible.form: natural adult humanoids with one head, two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet each
visual_bible.appearance: distinct faces and simple muted maroon/ochre garments; no grotesque caricature
visual_bible.grouping: small purposeful group, clearly separated from devas by position and clothing

never: no fused bodies or cloned faces
identity_scope: D027 scene continuity only; not an approved character master
